comments.author: Jafar
comments.body:
Quest:Learning from Paracelsus; Handicrafts13, Italian; Alexandria Merchant GM
In order to get job quest, pretty long chain quest must be done (all quest from Adventure GM's):
1. Quest: Request from alchemist; Italian, Arabic; Athens
2. Quest: Anima Mundi; Italian, Arabic; Athens, Naples, Genoa, Venice(?)
3. Quest: Mystery Of Kaballah; Italian, Arabic, Greek; Athens
4. Quest: Survey Of Pyramids Of Giza; Recognition1, Theology3, Arabic; Istanbul
5: Quest: Mysterious Documents; Search6, Appraisal8, Unlock6, Greek; Athens
6: Quest: Philospoher Stone; Search11, Appraisal13, Italian; Tunis, Naples, Athens, Istanbul (30K adventure fame needed)
